items.title: Tesla makes major Cybercab announcement as driverless vehicle goes on sale
items.summary: Tesla's Cybercab is now available to select customers for $29,990 with a $299 monthly autonomy subscription, but Elon Musk says the fee is too high.

items.title: Elon Musk's Tesla and SpaceX Lost More Than $420 Billion in Combined Market Value in Two Days After Democrats Swept the Midterms, With Investors Fearing New Congressional Probes. Here's Why That Political Risk Matters for Shareholders
items.summary: Given the nature of their businesses, Tesla and SpaceX's exposure to political risk won't subside anytime soon.

items.title: Elon Musk, other tech execs sign petition calling on Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang
items.summary: The petition had attracted more than 115,000 signatures as of Saturday afternoon.

items.title: Tesla opens Cybercab pre-orders ‘for personal use,’ with geo restrictions and a $299 monthly fee
items.summary: Even Elon Musk said the monthly fee is "too high."

items.title: Tesla (TSLA) Breaks Ground On $10 Billion Texas Solar Factory As EU Approvals Advance
items.summary: Tesla (NasdaqGS:TSLA) has started construction of its US$10b Crystal Sun solar factory in Texas, according to an announcement in November 2026. The Crystal Sun facility is planned to supply solar hardware linked to Tesla’s internal compute needs and energy storage products. Regulators in Slovakia and Finland granted key approvals for Tesla’s autonomous driving technology ahead of a broader EU decision. The Crystal Sun build and new Slovak and Finnish approvals only show part of Tesla’s story...

items.title: Tesla Just Started Taking Orders for a Car With No Steering Wheel
items.summary: The sticker price beats Musk's old promise, but a pre-checked box on the order page changes what you actually own. Add a federal safety probe and a car that runs only where Tesla allows, and the real cost gets complicated.

items.title: Elon Musk joins 100,000+ signers on a petition to reinstate Jensen Huang — including 5,000+ who say they work at Nvidia
items.summary: Billionaire investors, tech CEOs and thousands of people who say they’re current Nvidia employees have signed on, days after Huang resigned amid an alleged spy scandal and multiple alleged affairs.

items.title: Texas’ Next Attorney General Vows “Tremendous Scrutiny” of a Tesla–SpaceX Merger
items.summary: Texas' incoming attorney general has Elon Musk's biggest companies in his sights before any deal even exists. A little-known 1983 state law could let him slow a Tesla and SpaceX combination, and Tesla shareholders may pay the price.
